name: Hayman's Gently Rested Gin
production: Distilled, then rested three weeks in old Scotch whisky barrels
Nod to 1800s London gin palaces that sold gin from the cask
history: 1863 | Hayman family ancestor (a pharmacist) buys a gin rectifying business in Chelsea
expressions: Hayman's Royal Dock Gin | navy strength
serve_official: With ginger ale to bring out spicy, peppery notes
notes: Run by 5th-generation siblings James and Miranda Hayman with father Christopher; described as England's longest-serving gin distilling family. Launch year not found (backlog 2018). Info provided via The Gin Guild (brand-supplied).
